column1: # ACTION JZ (p174) -- gap 125 / T252. Is an EXACT count above 1 000 obtainable from this container?
# METHOD: the rendered github.com/search channel reports an EXACT integer at or below ~1 000 and a
# ROUNDED figure above it. So partition the anchor query into `pushed:` windows that each return
# under 1 000, read each window's exact integer, and sum. `pushed:` is a SINGLE value per
# repository, so the windows are DISJOINT and the sum is a count, not an estimate.
# ANCHOR (p173, recorded as "8.2k"): topic:education pushed:>=2026-04-16 license:mit
# CHANNEL: WebFetch over github.com/search?q=...&type=repositories. Query strings verbatim, per T227.
# FALSIFIER LIMB 1: "refuted if an exact four-figure count is obtainable by any channel available
#   here". IT FIRES -- 8191, by partition, on the one channel that answers at all.
# FALSIFIER LIMB 2: "ALSO refuted if the three channels disagree by >10pct". CANNOT FIRE AS WRITTEN:
#   two of the three channels the action named do not answer here at all (see
#   count-channel-ledger...p174.tsv). The partition total and the rounded total of the SAME channel
# LIMIT STATED: the 17 windows were read over ~40 min, not in one instant. A repository pushed
#   DURING the sweep is counted in its old window and again in the last one, so 8191 is an upper
#   bound; at the measured rate of the last window (819 over 3 days = ~11/h) the overlap is a
#   handful of rows, not a digit.
# SUBDIVISION CONTROL: two windows first came back ROUNDED and were split until each part was exact.
# AGREEMENT CONTROL: each rounded parent agrees with the sum of its exact parts: 1231 -> "1.2k",
# 2170 -> "2.2k". The rounding is to two significant figures, which is why 8.2k hid 8191.
# TOTAL: 17 disjoint windows, every one an exact integer, SUM = 8191.
